objectives.description: Write throwaway logging hook and register temporarily
Confirm literal unexpanded /please prompt text is logged by a real human prompt submission
objectives.note: Requested main (the interactive session) to relay a literal human-typed test prompt via SendMessage; no reply/log entry yet as of last check. Discovered an important related fact in the meantime: an inter-agent SendMessage delivery to main ALSO fires UserPromptSubmit in the receiving session, but the content arrives wrapped in <agent-message from="...">...</agent-message> tags -- confirmed by sending a message whose body literally started with '/please push origin ...': the logged .prompt value started with the <agent-message> wrapper, not literally with '/please'. This means a strict prefix-match mint grammar (startswith, not substring-contains) is safe against the agent-relay vector. Still need the literal human-typed confirmation before fully closing this objective; will retry opportunistically and finalize at Phase 13 live-fire if not landed sooner.
